text_block_list.name: Ayane
text_block_list.text:
That tag game was a total bust,
so next, let's settle this with Red Light, Green Light!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おにごっこは勝負がつかなかったから、
次は
「だるまさんが転んだ勝負」にしようよ！

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
You got it!
{0}, you're It again, 'kay? Ready... go!
text_block_list.orig_text:
さんせーっ！
今回も、にいちゃんが鬼ね。
よーい、
スタート！

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text:
Hoppety-hop, hoppety... Wahh!
Oww... I fell over...
text_block_list.orig_text:
るんたった
るんたっ……
きゃっ！
あうっ、
転んじゃったぁ～～

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Misogi, Kyoka...
It looks like I'm out this time...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ごめんね
ミソギちゃん、
キョウカちゃん。
ミミ、
アウトになっちゃった……

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
Urghhh... Now it's two against two...
Don't you worry, Mimi!
I won't let your sacrifice be in vain!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ううう……
これで、二対二か……
だいじょーぶだよミミ！
ミソギがミミの分まで頑張るもんね！

text_block_list.name: Kurumi
text_block_list.text: Ohhh... I'm getting all nervous...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うぅっ
……
緊張してきちゃった……

text_block_list.name: Kurumi
text_block_list.text: Wahhh?! I-I'm not... out, am I?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふえっ！？　
わ、
私、
アウトですか？

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
You were totally quivering all over!
That just leaves one enemy! This should be easy!
text_block_list.orig_text:
クルミの身体、
ぷるぷるしてたもんね～
これで敵はあと一人。
楽勝、
楽勝！

text_block_list.name: Ayane
text_block_list.text:
Urgh...
I-I've got to do my best...
text_block_list.orig_text:
う～
が、
がんばらなくちゃ……

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
Hmm?
Hang on. If there's only one enemy left...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん？　
敵があと一人ということは……

text_block_list.name: Ayane
text_block_list.text: *freeze!*
text_block_list.orig_text: ピタッ！

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
Take this! Misogi's funniest face!
Blegh-heh-heh!
text_block_list.orig_text:
必殺、
ミソギの変顔ー！
あっぷっぷ！

text_block_list.name: Ayane
text_block_list.text:
Pfft... Ahahahah!
Th-that's a dirty trick, making the opponent laugh!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぷっ！　
あはははーーー！
ず、ずるいぞ、
笑わせるなんてー！

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
Misogi!
Sure, you got Ayane out, but what's the use if you had to move?!
You're just as out as her!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ミソギ！
アヤネさんもアウトだけど、
ミソギまで動いてどうするの？
ミソギもアウトだよ！

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
Heheh...! And that just leaves you, Kyoka!
It's a victory for Little Lyrical!
text_block_list.orig_text:
へへ～ん、
これで残ったのはキョウカだけ！
【リトルリリカル】の勝利だよ～♪

text_block_list.name: Kurumi
text_block_list.text: Th-that's not fair...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ず、
ずるいです……

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: Misogi, that's not how you're supposed to play...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ミソギ、
それはいくらなんでも……

text_block_list.name: Ayane
text_block_list.text:
Urghhhh...
Sure, I guess I moved, but Pukichi didn't, did he?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
んーーーー
私は動いたけど……
ぷうきちは動いてないよね？

text_block_list.name: Pukichi
text_block_list.text: \"You betcha! I didn't move a single muscle!\"
text_block_list.orig_text:
『そうだな。
オレは動いてないからセーフだな』

text_block_list.name: Ayane
text_block_list.text: Well then, Pukichi, we're counting on you now!
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあぷうきち、
あとはお願いね！

text_block_list.name: Misogi & Kyoka
text_block_list.text: Whaaa...?!
text_block_list.orig_text: ええっ！？

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
H-hold on a minute!
Pukichi isn't capable of moving in the first place!
That's not fair at all!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょ、
ちょっと待ってください！
そもそもぷうきちは
動けないじゃないですか！　
ずるいです！

text_block_list.name: Ayane
text_block_list.text:
It's totally fair!
Pukichi's my friend, so he gets to play too!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ずるくないもんっ！
ぷうきちは私の友達だからいいんだもん！

text_block_list.name: Kurumi
text_block_list.text: Yes, that's right!
text_block_list.orig_text: そうだよ～！

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
T-talk about clever...
I can't believe she outdid me, the Prank Master, at trickery...
That Ayane's one to watch out for...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
そうきたか……
イタズラの天才、
ミソギの上をいくなんて、
アヤネもあなどれないなぁ～

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: ...Misogi?
text_block_list.orig_text: ミソギ？

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text: Kyoka, you're not thinking he's not a real friend, are you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
キョウカ、
まさかクマさんは
友達じゃないとか思ってる？

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: Huhhh?! O-of course not...
text_block_list.orig_text:
えぇっ！？　
そんなことは……！

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text: Now now, Kyoka. It's not nice to pick on people's friends.
text_block_list.orig_text:
キョウカちゃん、
お友達を差別するのは良くないよ……

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: I-I wasn't trying to do anything like...
text_block_list.orig_text:
わ、
私は別に
そんなつもりじゃ……

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
Urghh... A-all right, then.
I suppose I'll acknowledge Pukichi...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うぅ……
わ、
わかりました。
ぷうきちを認めます……

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
In the end, Pukichi didn't move a muscle for the whole game,
winning the match for Ayane and Kurumi.
text_block_list.orig_text:
結局、一切動く気配がないぷうきちが最後まで残り、
アヤネとクルミのチームが勝利した。
